sources.title: Z.ai GLM-5.3 HF weights/model card (license, serving, boundary date)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The zai-org/GLM-5.3 Hugging Face repository exposes full weights (753B parameters; BF16/F8_E4M3/F32 safetensors) with Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers, Unsloth, and Docker serving paths; reasoning_effort accepts low/high/max (default max) and the card references paper arXiv 2602.15763.
claims.context: Retrieved HF model-card content consumed; repo facts transcribed as observed.

claims.text: Card-reported gains over GLM-5.2 from post-training only include +50% on the in-house Z.ai Code Bench, open-source SOTA on Terminal Bench 3.0 and Agents' Last Exam, CyberGym 84.5 SOTA with doubled exploitation-chain gains, plus table figures such as Terminal Bench 2.1 88.2, AutomationBench 48.2, and GDPval-AA v2 1769.
claims.context: Card-reported benchmark table; externally unreproduced in this run.

claims.text: The card License field reads glm-5.3 (custom), which is distinct from the MIT grant associated with the GLM-5.3-Flash variant; no MIT license is established for these full GLM-5.3 weights in the consumed authority.
claims.context: License-field transcription as observed; license text itself was not consumed, so downstream use must not assert MIT terms.

claims.text: The edition-attributed date 2026-08-28 carries UTC-hour uncertainty because the retrieved markdown shows no explicit publication date; the record is treated as an ordinary-window boundary item with medium confidence rather than a carry-over.
claims.context: Boundary disposition from collector provenance note plus the W36 window opening at 2026-08-28 22:00 UTC; date-only attribution cannot resolve the hour.

limitations.text: UTC hour on 2026-08-28 is unresolved, so window placement is medium-confidence ordinary-boundary; hour-level precision must not be asserted.
